name: Autumn add / drop deadline
notes: After this date a module change is recorded as a withdrawal and appears on the transcript.

name: Spring 2026/27 registration window
notes: Seat allocation is first-come, first-served within each registration group.

name: Library items escalate to a financial hold
notes: Unresolved Short Loan items convert to a replacement charge on this date and the block becomes a financial hold clearable only by the Fees Office (10 working days).

name: Spring fee payment due
notes: A late payment is accepted for 14 days with a EUR 50 administration charge.
